verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a release note saying users can share images of existing data, such as spreadsheets, for Poke to extract and visualize as tables and charts. That is image-based extraction rather than native upload and analysis of document, spreadsheet, or PDF files. Missing for 10: native upload of documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs, evidence of accurate content analysis beyond visualization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
